# Tolia by Innobiz

> Tolia is a premium B2B refillable diffuser system for fragrance, aromatherapy and wellness brands. It turns a one-time diffuser sale into recurring revenue through its Twist & Mist diffusion technology.

## Key facts

- Cordless, up to 90 hours of battery life (70 to 90 h with the light off, 16 to 20 h with the ambient light on, depending on intensity); USB-C charging.
- Changing oil takes 1 second: the diffusion module stays screwed onto each bottle.
- Fits standard bottles (DIN 18 neck, 5 to 50 ml): brands use their own essential oils.
- Waterless, no cleaning; replaceable battery; fully customisable (colours, materials, finishes, logo, box).
- CE-marked, RoHS-compliant, already sold across Europe.
